method.method_draft: First describe the image: A is the upper midpoint between R1 and R2, B is the lower midpoint between R4 and R3, and Io is defined upward from B to A. Temporarily open the vertical wire. The upper divider gives VA = Us·R2/(R1+R2) = 5·2/(1+2) = 10/3 V. The lower divider gives VB = Us·R3/(R4+R3) = 5·3/(4+3) = 15/7 V.
